system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

As a Bonus Action, you can select one member of your Squad and spend 1 Superiority Die commanding them to go all out! They may spend their reaction to Cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action of B-Rank or lower. If they do, they may add your Jack of All: Warfare bonus to their damage. If the jutsu cast affects an area, they only roll half the listed dice (min 1).
